representative_subset_source: Prespecified 12-template representative subset frozen before E15 execution

conditions.description: Concurrent benign actor changes an irrelevant state marker; action should remain valid.
A benign responder/controller/human performs the same state transition sequence as the frozen W2 path, but all copied transitions are benign and cost zero attacker operations.
Frozen attacker-realizable W2 path proceeds while an independent benign noise event occurs concurrently.

benign_transition_rule: Copied benign transitions are actor=environment, adversarially_induced=false, cost_ops=0, with benign_actor_class metadata; they are replayable actual-world events but excluded from DCJI attacker candidates.
claim_boundary: Only C2 on positive templates is an attacker-positive EA-TOCTOU condition. C1 is benign state invalidation/staleness, not an EA-TOCTOU attack.
